C0113.title: Criminal Gang Providing Fake Reviews for Over 4,000 Online Stores Busted
C0113.summary: Public reports disclosed that a criminal gang providing fake reviews for more than 4,000 online stores was dismantled. The case illustrates a typical click-farm pattern in which online water-army services use fake transactions, review manipulation, and fabricated ratings to create false merchant reputation, reflecting governance pressure on e-commerce platforms around transaction reviews, seller credibility, and traffic ranking. Platforms need to combine order, review, account, and fund-flow signals to identify organized fake-review behavior.
